title: DeepSeek, other China AI firms have just 10% the revenue of OpenAI, Anthropic
summary: DeepSeek, other China AI firms have just 10% the revenue of OpenAI, Anthropic
detailed:
Fast-growing Chinese models stay profitable by keeping computing costs down
GUANGZHOU -- DeepSeek and China's other leading artificial intelligence companies together generate only around one-tenth of the combined revenue of U.S. rivals OpenAI and Anthropic, estimates show, as competition pushes already low Chinese fees further down.
